scope: Read-only diagnostic runs comparing public MJWarp cone/impratio settings after the dt-convergence gate; no production edits, training, FPS, or 830xx use.

common.assets_and_reset: Reuse v2 seed, task, robot/flat Field USD assets, and reset snapshot procedure; compare the full initial_state_canonical_sha256 and fixed physical contract externally. A mismatch stays pending and is not labeled paired.
common.same_slot_capture: Reuse v2 native pre-solver callback and raw qd/target/integral/applied-effort tapes without changing the sampling kernel.
common.required_runtime_option_evidence: Record host mj_model.opt.cone/impratio and mjw_model.opt.cone/impratio_invsqrt; verify the configured cone and impratio, with MJWarp invsqrt=1/sqrt(impratio). Also dump selected Newton shape_material_mu/kf/ke/kd and runtime MuJoCo geom friction/condim/solref/solimp.

baseline.actual_option_limit: v2 recorded the runtime cone enum and configured cone, but did not expose host mj_model.opt.impratio; v3 adds direct runtime verification before accepting a run.

retained_failed_attempt.status: failed before reset and before controlled motion; raw summary, log, and exit record are retained
retained_failed_attempt.failure: MJWarp opt.impratio_invsqrt was a one-element array [1.0]; the initial preflight incorrectly attempted scalar float conversion.

acceptance: Refuse overwrite of each fresh output, log, and exit record.
Require configured and actual host/MJWarp cone and impedance values to match each treatment.
Require the expected native callback sample count, finite native qd/applied effort, effort <=2 Nm+1e-5, and uncapped PI expression residual <=1e-4 Nm when samples are usable.
Retain full raw policy and same-slot native samples, canonical initial-state hash, fixed contract hash, source hashes, package-version record, and true process exit code.
Report final-1s yaw, native qd variability, effort, slip/friction/normal statistics, and runtime solver/material fields; no causal conclusion if the canonical reset or fixed contract differs.
